gia.name: Grant-in-Aid research project
tips: Use the DRDO ER/RB-01 format: title, type (basic/applied/futuristic), problem statement, aims, deliverables, duration and grant with justification, and novelty.
The proposal must show how it advances aeronautical R&D for the country: aircraft, helicopters, missiles or other airborne vehicles.
Proposals go to a specialist panel; expect a presentation. Products and processes are later evaluated by the panel or appointed monitors.
A PI may submit a given proposal to only one DRDO research board.
